model_definition: Perspective-Informed Heterogeneous Graph Attention Network for Triads; operational project definition, not a claim of canonical architecture external to this repository.
threshold_policy: No arbitrary pass/fail threshold. Formal reference is exact equality (score 1.0) to deterministic RDF/SHACL properties; observed model metrics are reported without empirical interpretation.

target_properties.mirrorOf: same triad; opposite phase; reciprocal; lateral positions exchange and center remains center
target_properties.creates: same triad; opposite phase; follows the four declared left/center-to-center/laterals creation rules
